exportSummaries.FOOT_BASE_CYCLE_S: Foot-base stride-retarget slice (SC-05, `?footBase=1`, 1.31 m route only): path-data literals, the opt-in parser, schedule/role math, and the stateful walking substep.
exportSummaries.FOOT_BASE_LIFT_PHASE: Lift phase per foot (fraction of the loop period): the row-table datum's stance interval for this foot is plantPhase..liftPhase (mod 1).

exportSummaries.FOOT_BASE_STANCE_FRACTION: Stance fraction per foot ((lift - plant) mod 1): left 0.6403, right 0.5361.
exportSummaries.LocomotionStanceLabels: Per-clip stance labels from the clip's own motion, sampled once per slot.
exportSummaries.STOP_CROSSFADE_SECONDS: Walk-to-stop crossfade window in seconds: walk fades 1 to 0 while the stop fades 0 to 1.
exportSummaries.STOP_PLAYING_FLAG: Distance-indexed stop-take playback: start the root-removed take at the entry clip time (distance-driven, never mixer-integrated), morph the walk/stop weights across the entry crossfade, and manage stopping entry, crossfade, exits, and the settle-blend.
exportSummaries.StopClipPlaybackState: The slice of the case-owned approach the stop mixer touches.

exportSummaries.footBaseHalfIndex: 1-based passing-to-passing half containing this unwrapped action time.

exportSummaries.footBaseScheduleStance: Schedule-only stance foot at this loop phase: each foot is stance over exactly its plant-to-lift contact interval.
